facts.business: TIPS MUSIC LIMITED is engaged in the business of production, acquisition, and monetisation of audio-visual music content library in India and overseas through licensing on various platforms.
key_risks: Revenue recognition involves assessing contractual terms, interpreting usage data and reports received from multiple platforms, and judgment in ensuring revenue is recorded in the correct period and amount.
facts.related_party_note: Transactions with related parties are in compliance with Sections 177 and 188 of the Act, where applicable, and details have been disclosed in the financial statements as required by applicable accounting standards.
